_staleness_note: ref_date drives the ±3 price-staleness rule and is set ONLY on manager and strategic (13F) signals — Q1→period-end 2026-03-31, Q4→2025-12-31. Insider signals are sell-side warnings and are intentionally EXEMPT (no ref_date): a resolved sell decays via the quarterly human refresh, not buy-entry staleness arithmetic. Price/earnings/screen/senate are events and are also exempt. Do not add ref_date to those lanes.
